column3: MT 8:5. “The honor is yours” renders “Glorify yourself over me.”
MT 8:8. “which He had inflicted upon” renders “which He had set on.”
MT 8:12. “gnats” renders “kinnim,” an uncertain insect (perhaps lice).
MT 8:17. “swarms of insects” renders “arov,” an uncertain word (perhaps flies).
MT 8:19. “a division” renders “pedut,” which usually means “redemption”; the Greek reads “a distinction.”
MT 8:22. “an abomination to the Egyptians” follows the Hebrew.
